summary: This bill establishes mandatory minimum prison sentences for various federal fraud offenses, imposing a minimum of one year for fraud involving $1,000,000 to $5,000,000 and five years for fraud involving $5,000,000 or more, unless current law already provides for a longer sentence.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes mandatory minimum prison sentences for various fraud offenses, directly leading to stricter justice and stronger policing by ensuring longer incarceration for these crimes. This is the central purpose of the bill.
